## What changed

Describe the new case, correction, or tooling change.

## Source and attribution

Link the original post and the prompt-bearing reply, if different.

## Checks

- [ ] English and Chinese content are complete.
- [ ] Prompt provenance, model claims, reference requirements, and rights are accurate.
- [ ] Metric snapshots have a source and capture time; unavailable counts stay null.
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run check` pass; generated files are included.
- [ ] PR title uses an English Conventional Commit format.
